integrity: Self-contained full proof and reproducible standalone diagnostic; finite numerical checks supplement analysis rather than proving infinitely many parameter values.
scientific_limitations: Fixed nonconstant polynomial and positive parameter a tending to zero; no uniform degree estimates or complete finite-exponent spectra. Degree-one restriction was already covered by cited 2025 prior work; no independent certification.
title: Two-term Dirichlet-energy expansion of polynomial multiplier norms at a degenerate kernel
